easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
